component.name: Anyscale
component.summary: Connect to several tailnets at once

description.p: Anyscale is a fork of Trayscale that talks to tailmix instead of tailscaled, so one machine can stay connected to several Tailscale and Headscale tailnets at the same time.
It needs the tailmix daemon, tailmixd, to be installed and running. Adding, removing and enabling tailnets and choosing an exit node ask for administrator access through polkit.

ul.li: Fork of Trayscale v0.21.0 on top of tailmix v0.1.20.
Sidebar that lists every tailnet with its own connect switch.
Add tailnets on Tailscale or any Headscale server from the GUI.
Exit node selection goes through the tailmix daemon.
